gyujeongion-claude-code-sandbox-gate-san.description: A verification gate that runs BEFORE a change touches main/production. Instead of accepting "it works now," it re-states what the change actually promises, scans the architecture it touches, reproduces it in an isolated sandbox, runs it against golden / edge / failure / concurrency cases, traces the flow for accidental passes, and only then reports whether it's safe to apply. Use when an agent is about to apply a fix, when you say "/sandbox-gate", "verify before applying", "is this change actually safe", "test this properly, not a quick check", "don't patch and pray".
